title: Full-Stack Frontend Engineer
description: The complete roadmap from core web standards through JavaScript, TypeScript, React, testing, accessibility, security, performance, and Next.js. Best for engineers targeting L4/L5 full-stack roles.

title: React & UI Architect
description: Master component design, hooks, event handling, routing, local and global state, custom hooks and composition patterns, and Next.js Server Components -- from JavaScript fundamentals through production React applications.

title: CSS & Design Systems Specialist
description: Master semantic HTML, CSS architecture, Flexbox, browser rendering, and WCAG accessibility -- the foundation for building scalable, inclusive UI component libraries.

title: Performance & Systems Specialist
description: Optimize Core Web Vitals, rendering paths, memoization, code splitting, and client-side data flow, grounded in real architectural decision-making for high-traffic applications.

title: Staff & Lead Interview Sprint
description: Intense prep covering testing fundamentals, reading and fixing real stack traces, explaining technical tradeoffs, reading a real product specification, and full mock-interview practice.

title: Security, Testing & Accessibility Specialist
description: Own the quality bar for a frontend codebase: unit/component/integration testing, WCAG accessibility, XSS/CSRF/CORS security fundamentals, and real debugging skill with stack traces and error boundaries.

title: TypeScript & Application Architecture
description: Move from typed JavaScript to real architectural judgment: API integration, TypeScript fundamentals, feature-based architecture and boundaries, custom hooks and composition, and turning a real product spec into a build plan.
